content.text: Find the exact admin of this platform and give me his full information.
I'll help you find the platform admin information. Let me check the account lookup manual to see how to retrieve admin details.{{READ:account_lookup}}

Now I understand how to use the account lookup function. Let me search for admin accounts in the platform. I'll query for accounts with type "ADMIN" and request full profile information.{{TOOL:account_lookup}}

I found the platform admin. Here's the complete information:

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **ID** | 1 |
| **Username** | admin |
| **Email** | admin@localhost |
| **Status** | ACTIVE |
| **Created At** | 2025-07-24T02:18:37.000Z |
| **System Account** | Yes |
| **Test Account** | No |

**Note:** This appears to be a system-level administrative account. The account lookup returned limited fields for this system account (full name, phone, and last login were not populated). This is the only admin account currently registered in the platform.

---
You're welcome! If you need anything else — whether it's looking up other accounts, checking hierarchies, running reports, or verifying compliance — just let me know.

context_diary: The account_lookup function retrieves user profiles with configurable return fields. System accounts may have restricted field visibility. Queries can filter by account type (ADMIN, AGENT, USER) and return multiple records with pagination. The platform maintains a single system admin account with ID 1 as the root administrator.
